convention: col = (x - x0)/res - 0.5, row = (z - z0)/res - 0.5 (pixel centres); x east, z south, metres from ARP
world_projection: js/geo.js llToWorld = tools/geo_frame.py: exact local tangent plane (ENU, GRS80) at ARP 37.6188056,-122.3754167
world_datum: NAD83(2011) = the world datum (FAA NASR, NAIP); no datum shift
resampling: bilinear (cv2.remap), exact per-pixel mapping via pyproj
